text:
anne: Quick heads-up — rolling out a billing cutover next Wednesday to smooth rate-limit bursts and introduce a temporary soft overage cap. Short thread with TL;DR + action items.

sanjay: TL;DR? what exactly is changing?

anne: TL;DR: two coordinated changes: 1) a short-term rate-limit smoothing window for 30s bursty traffic to reduce immediate 429s; 2) an overage billing policy update that adds a soft cap and pro-rata credits for impacted customers during the transition. No changes to enterprise Private contracts.

jordan: timeline? how long is the soft cap active?

anne: rollout window = 2026-04-01 00:00 UTC -> 2026-04-15 23:59 UTC. Soft cap is active during that period. After that we'll switch back to standard overage invoicing unless we extend.

emily: is this for hosted only or dedicated too?

anne: hosted API customers will see rate-limit smoothing & soft cap. Dedicated customers on committed plans are unaffected on billing mechanics (they already have reserved capacity). Private deployments unchanged.

ops-oncall: ops note — smoothing means we buffer very short bursts server-side up to 30s and allow graceful queueing. We still enforce per-key QPS ceilings; this just avoids immediate rejections for sharp short spikes.

billing-bot: Automated note: customers who exceed commit during the window will see an invoice line item: `SOFT_CAP_ADJUSTMENT` with 0-50% discount depending on overage severity. Pro-rata credits will be applied automatically. Full line item details: ```
- usage_units: <tokens>
- unit_price: <¢/token>
- soft_cap_applied: true/false
- credit_amount: <USD>
```

jordan: will customers be notified? Slack/email?

anne: We'll send two comms: 1) customer-facing email tonight with details and FAQ link; 2) in-console banner starting 2026-03-30. Sales/AMs will get a tailored template to share with enterprise customers.

emily: docs link?

anne: Draft doc: https://redwood.example/docs/billing/smooth-cap-2026 (internal for now). Public doc goes live same day as rollout.

sanjay: billing implications for free credits? any change to trial credit expiry or carry-forward?

anne: short answer: trial credits expiry not changing, but we will apply pro-rata adjustments to accounts that were in free credit expiry window and hit rate limits during the transition. That prevents customers from being charged unexpectedly when their free credits end during rollout.

ops-oncall: monitoring: will add a dashboard card under Console -> Billing -> Usage Anomalies. Alert threshold = >10% weekly spike after smoothing enabled.

jordan: what do we need from Eng/Infra?

ops-oncall: infra needs to enable the smoothing toggle in the edge service for the rollout window. Also a short runbook update: if smoothing causes latency regressions >50ms P95 we will back it out.

anne: action items: 
- @sanjay please finalize customer email by EOD today.
- @jordan add toggle and circuit-breaker to edge service PR by Tue.
- @emily coordinate AM templates and private customer notices.
- @ops-oncall add dashboard and alert.

billing-bot: FYI: invoices generated during the window will include `policy-note: smoothing-rollout-2026-04` on the JSON payload. Billing team: ensure accounting mappings for the `SOFT_CAP_ADJUSTMENT` line item.

anne: risks: small margin hit if we end up crediting many accounts. Benefit: fewer support tickets and better developer experience.

emily: noted — I'll prep a short Q&A for Support with sample email language and recovery steps.

sanjay: thanks all. If anything changes I'll update thread. :)

anne: Thanks — please escalate any blocker to me or @ops-oncall. :thumbsup:
